subject: QuantumLedger — priority alignment request: tenant affinity & audit export
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@quantumledger.com>, Dan Cole <dan.cole@quantumledger.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuantumLedger — priority alignment request: tenant affinity & audit export

Hi team,

Following our call with QuantumLedger this morning, they're asking us to prioritize two related capabilities for their onboarding:

1) Per-tenant routing affinity (model residency/affinity) so specific customers' requests hit a pinned model pool for consistent latency and auditability.
2) Streaming audit export (near-real-time event stream with token-level logs stripped of PII) to feed their SIEM and satisfy internal compliance.

Why this is urgent: QuantumLedger has an executive go/no-go on 2026-10-15 and procurement needs an ETA to finalize a committed capacity purchase (they're willing to sign a 12-month dedicated reservation if we can guarantee a delivery window).

Ask: can Product/Eng evaluate whether we can (A) deliver a minimal gating approach for routing affinity + an initial audit-export stream within a near-term sprint, and (B) give a realistic ETA and what we would need (scope, test plan, tradeoffs)? I've attached the customer's requirements doc and the preliminary SOW they shared.

Attachments: quantum_requirements_v1.pdf

Thanks — happy to sync after you review.

Connor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@quantumledger.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantumLedger — priority alignment request: tenant affinity & audit export

Connor — thanks for the context and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions before we scope:

- For routing affinity: do they require strict single-tenant residency (dedicated pool) or soft affinity (preferential routing with fallback)?
- For audit export: what retention and TTL do they expect, and do they need raw tokens or redacted structured events?
- Expected peak QPS and concurrent sessions for the first 90 days?

Tradeoffs to call out upfront: full single-tenant residency has capacity/cost implications and will likely need Dedicated changes; a soft-affinity + cache-warm strategy is much faster. For audit streams, delivering token-level exports will need redaction tooling and privacy review which affects ETA.

Can you ask Priya to confirm the two bullets above (they can answer in-thread). Also, Connor, please paste the HubSpot deal ID and any budget commitment they can put on the table — that materially changes prioritization. I'll pull in our prioritization matrix and propose where this lands relative to current sprint commitments.

Laura
Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: QuantumLedger — priority alignment request: tenant affinity & audit export

Laura — answers from Priya (copied) and quick deal context:

Priya (QuantumLedger):
- "We want deterministic affinity for compliance reasons — not necessarily an exclusive single-tenant GPU pool day-1, but an affinity guarantee that on >=99.5% of requests from our tenant will be routed to the same logical model pool. Fallback to general pool is acceptable during saturation.
- Audit stream: we need near-real-time events (<=60s delay), PII redaction per the attached spec, retention of 90 days in their SIEM. Token-level detail preferred but we can accept structured events if it preserves prompt/response context.
- Peak: expect ~40 QPS initially, spiking to 120 QPS over first 3 months as we ramp."

Deal notes: HubSpot deal ID: QL-2026-0930. QuantumLedger has a $1.2M ARR target for the first year and is prepared to commit to a 12-month dedicated reservation if we can provide a delivery commitment by 2026-10-15. They've sent a draft SOW (attached) and legal (Dan) will coordinate redlines.

I'm attaching the SOW draft now: sow_draft.docx

Connor

Subject: Re: QuantumLedger — priority alignment request: tenant affinity & audit export

Thanks for the details — looks like a feasible ask but with a couple of important constraints. High-level notes from engineering:

1) Proposal: split into two deliverables for quicker time-to-value:
   - Phase A (MVP, target 3-week cycle): soft routing affinity + a basic audit stream that emits structured, redacted events (no raw token export). This would satisfy procurement gate and the customer's 10/15 exec review as long as we get a canary by 10/01.
   - Phase B (staged, 6-8 weeks): hardened affinity with tighter SLA and optional dedicated pool plumbing + token-level exports behind an explicit privacy sign-off and additional cost.

2) Constraints/asks from Eng:
   - We'll need a signed commitment (deal ID QL-2026-0930) and a product/CS acceptance criteria doc that lists the minimum event fields and sanity-check prompts.
   - Observability: add tracing hooks and a rate-limited export queue to avoid cascade failures. That will add ~3-5 days of infra work.

3) Rough ETA if we greenlight and reprioritize next sprint: Phase A can be canaried by 2026-10-01, Phase B then staged in the following 6–8 weeks. This assumes no other high-priority commits drop into the sprint.

Next step: Laura — if Product agrees, Markus/Eng can kickoff a scoping session tomorrow (prep: acceptance criteria doc + the SOW). Connor/Monica please coordinate with QuantumLedger legal to get sign-off on the commitment and share the acceptance criteria once ready.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
